title: Python Developer
description: We are hiring a Python Developer to build and maintain backend services. You will design REST APIs with Flask, work with SQL databases, write unit tests and collaborate using Git. Exposure to machine learning is a plus.
education_requirement: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field

title: Data Analyst
description: Join our analytics team to turn business data into insight. You will clean and analyse data, write SQL queries, build Power BI dashboards and present findings to stakeholders. Strong Excel and data visualization skills required.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to train, evaluate and deploy models. You will work with Python, TensorFlow or PyTorch, scikit-learn and NLP techniques, and ship models as REST APIs using Docker.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Build responsive user interfaces with React and TypeScript. You will consume REST APIs, write clean HTML and CSS, and collaborate with designers and backend engineers using Git.
